title: Project 04 — Stimulus Payload v1 (LOCKED v1.0)
description: LOCKED v1.0 (2026-06-09, D-PROJ04-005). A shared stimulus stored once and referenced by many questions via question.stimulus_ref (QDN-09). It is the body that rides under envelope.payload when doc_type='stimulus' (a new import doc_type added in deliverable 5). Rationale: the envelope is one-doc-per-file, so a passage reused across questions cannot live inside one question; inlining it would duplicate-and-drift, the very thing the JSON-canonical decision (QDN-01) removes. Already-live reuse: ENG U09 listening (audio_script) and BAN U13 poem. STANDARDS: content language single-by-subject — Bangla, ENG excepted (envelope.subject governs; harness scans ENG content Latin-pure); REF-22 glossary; REF-24/REF-01 C-05/C-02 media (diagram-only). Like the question payload, it does NOT carry subject/class_level — those stay on the envelope (no duplication, nothing to mismatch).
$comment: Draft 2020-12, house style mirrors the question payload and C5_PlanSchema_v1.json: additionalProperties:false, $defs for reuse, allOf+if/then on the stimulus_type discriminator. glossItem and mediaRef are intentionally identical to the question payload's $defs of the same name (kept in sync in deliverable 5). Harness-owed (not expressible here): stimulus_id uniqueness across the store, and that every question.stimulus_ref resolves to a stored stimulus_id.

stimulus_id.description: Stable stimulus id, the target of question.stimulus_ref. PROPOSED scheme (confirm): STIM-{SUBJECT}-C{class}-U{unit}[-L{lesson}]-{nn}, e.g. STIM-ENG-C5-U09-01. Permanent, never reused.

stimulus_type.description: passage = prose comprehension text; poem = stanzas; audio_script = text the teacher reads aloud for a listening task (no audio asset in build 1); image_set = a set of diagram-only figures with framing text.

title.description: Optional. Human-readable name (e.g. the poem/passage title) for teacher recognition and rendering.

content.description: The readable stimulus body: the prose, the stanzas, the listening script, or — for image_set — the framing/instruction text (the figures themselves go in media).

glossary.description: Optional. REF-22 receptive words glossed for this stimulus (same content language); referencing questions inherit the gloss.

media.description: Optional in general; REQUIRED when stimulus_type='image_set'. Diagram-only (non-living-being) figures.

allOf.$comment: image_set must carry at least one figure.

ref.description: Stored asset reference/id (the app holds the asset; no embedded blob).

alt_text.description: Required. Described-text equivalent of the figure.

curation_status.description: Author/reviewer-set REF-01 C-05/C-02 clearance. 'replaced' reserved (only if image scope 9-B is ever opened).
